_about: The dashboard To-Do feed: a short, layman-readable daily checklist of curation work (for Sam) and engineering/pre-curation work (for Fable, the Claude session), rendered by cpl_todos.js as the 📋 To-Do button on every tab. Refreshed at every Rule-8 checkpoint alongside the session handoff (this file is the handoff distilled for the dashboard). Check-off state lives in each viewer's browser (localStorage) and resets when _as_of changes. Keep it SHORT — ≤ ~12 items; done items are deleted, not checked.
_status: SESSION 68 (SkyAlizarin) — two fixes + a masthead makeover. (1) The daily refresh was 'spotty': GitHub's scheduler DELAYS our cron 1.5–4h (not drops), so it published mid-morning instead of overnight — pulled it EARLIER + added a 3rd backstop (now ~11 PM / 2 AM / 5 AM PT) (#485). (2) Found the REAL culprit for today's miss: a momentary Supabase network blip was killing the ENTIRE daily run because one sync step wasn't guarded — fixed (retry + non-fatal) so a hiccup can never blank the dashboard again (#486); today was re-published. (3) Consolidated the COBI header into a clean single-row 'app bar': seal + COBI (gold CPL) / 'Chancellor's Office Business Intelligence' under it · a centered 'Where To?' search · a subtle ℹ About menu (Project Description / Attachments / Cheat Sheet / Today's painting) · 'Manually Refresh COBI'. Built, tested (61 test files green), ready on PR #487 — HOLDING the merge on just one thing: Sam's seal upload.

items.text: ⭐ ONE quick thing unlocks the new header: upload the Chancellor's Office seal to the repo. Go to github.com/CPL-Initiative/cpl-project-tracker/upload/claude/awesome-brown-dyd33o → drag the seal in → 'Commit directly to the claude/awesome-brown-dyd33o branch.' Name it cccco_seal.png (any name is fine — just tell me). Then I'll match COBI's blue exactly to the seal, merge, and the new masthead goes live. (Or say 'merge now' and the seal slots in when you upload it.)

Heads-up: the top of COBI is getting simpler — one tidy row: the seal + COBI on the left, a 'Where To?' quick-search in the middle, and the small links tucked into an 'ℹ About' menu on the right (with Today's painting). Preview prototypes were shared in chat (cobi_header_v1..v5). It goes live right after the seal lands.

The CPL News tab is LIVE — it auto-harvests California CPL news first + national, every day, and Claude triages it (no hand-curation). Eyeball items, use ★ Feature / Hide to curate, and 'Suggest a story' to drop in any link (incl. a LinkedIn/X/Facebook/Instagram post). News stays PRIVATE to the CPLBrain vault for now (your call, 2026-06-22).

Pick your college on the TMC Builder — every TMC shows whether you already hold that ADT: ✓ Active (live in your catalog) vs ✓ Approved (CO-approved, pending activation) + ⏳ In progress / ◐ Teach-out. We're building this toward a CO REVIEW tool that auto-checks a college's courses against each TMC's C-ID requirements. Spot-check your college's badges.

The Knowledge Base tab is LIVE — sign in and try the ✍️ New-doc composer: write/paste notes, attach a file (text, PDF, Word, Excel, or a screenshot), ✨ Polish with Claude, then 'Open in GitHub →' to commit it as yourself. Please smoke-test all five attachment types and flag any red error chip.

✨ Suggested merges (data lane): groups by the obvious keyword (Algebra, the languages, ESL, ECE/EMT/CNA/HVAC/LVN). Confirm the obvious families; UNCHECK or Skip a genuine progression (units are the tell). Popup tools: '➕ Add by keyword', the 🏷 'match strength' slider, title-cleanup on a different target, a Completion-note box.

PRIORITY: finish PR #487 (COBI masthead). When Sam uploads the seal → git pull, point the at it, SAMPLE its exact navy into the --seal-blue token in BOTH HTMLs (now #00356B), commit, squash-merge, then mcp__github__actions_run_trigger the daily workflow (it's a code-only PR — PROJ-INFO markers empty, Refresh generator-injected). Method: docs/kb-notes/methodology-regen-safe-section-rework.md + docs/cobi_lessons.md. Don't break the regen — the generator is anchor-parked, prove idempotency by running it twice.

Then (Sam: 'Go for A'): build the Phase-2 ACCEPTANCE ENGINE in tmc_builder.js — per-slot verdict from the ASCCC rules (C-ID match = ✓ accept · slot.flexible = ⚠ accept-with-ASSIST · specific C-ID filled by a non-match = faculty review · unfilled = ○) + structural checklist (major ≥18 sem · ≤60 · select-counts) + a 'Ready / N issues' banner. Consume slot.flexible + t.flexibility (#479). Demo on Allan Hancock vs San Diego City. Commit a jsdom test. Scope: docs/kb-notes/tmc-co-review-scope.md.

CPL News follow-ups (after Sam reviews the feed): tune GOOGLE_NEWS_QUERIES + RELEVANCE_MIN (0.4) in the cpl-news-harvest function (mirror news/sources.json, redeploy via Supabase MCP — verify_jwt:false, capability-probe auth); optionally decode Google News redirect URLs → final links. News stays vault-private. Docs: docs/cpl_news_lessons.md.

CCR data passes (queued, measure-first, own dry-run PRs): (1) the morphological-variant pass — Medical Assisting vs Assistant, the -ing/-ant/-ology family (lemmatize/stem the title token before _sug_sig); MEASURE regroup + over-merge first. (2) On Sam's go, DRY-RUN title-lane pass 2 (kb/_auto_merge_worklist.py --pass2-title); apply only on sign-off, then re-key Supabase + dispatch.

Write the Playwright bulk-PCF extractor for Sam to run (DevExpress College_MCF.aspx: per college select → View Report → Export CSV). Then tmc/_build_college_adt_courses.py joins PCF→COCI → per (college,ADT) real member courses + C-ID/units = the Phase-1 current-state bootstrap. Also: harden kb/college_short_names.json aliases; faculty-verify the 45 TMC drafts.
